verdict.rationale: Pigment's security page says customers choose the region where their data is stored, either Frankfurt (europe-west3) or Oregon (us-west1), which directly delivers region selection. Missing for 10: regions beyond EU and US, in-depth documentation on how and when the region is chosen or whether it can be migrated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Customer data is stored in the region you choose: europe-west3 (Frankfurt, Germany) or us-west1 (Oregon, USA).
